purpose: Hash-pinned controlled W4L1 combined trace for shared moving-platform motion and same-tick player carry consumption.

controls: platform aligned to the live player at x=-8,y=-8 before the first callback
initializer/carry gate fields cleared by the debugger harness before the first callback

observations.platform_motion: The seeded 0x00028000 fixed-point X velocity is integrated by 01F7:9DC7; integer position advances 2 or 3 pixels per callback while the raw fractional position is retained.

first_carry.player_record: The complete 0x78-byte player record moves from fixed X 0x02000000 to 0x02020001 and from fixed Y 0x01900000 to 0x01880002 in the first nested callback.

observations.recontact_state: After the first accepted carry, the next platform callback clears +0x5A and starts the observed +0x58=0x14 cooldown; subsequent samples continue platform motion but publish no carry while the player remains outside the accepted recontact path.

confirmed: Platform motion and the nested player callback occur in the recovered order.
A075/A0B2 publishes fixed-point carry before 3FF8, and 3FF8 consumes and clears both carry words in the same callback.
The platform callback does not directly write the player record.
still_open: Natural authored platform landing and inherited launch velocity.
Attached-player behavior when the platform is culled or the scheduler bank is rebuilt.
Whether the observed recontact cooldown is the complete retail attachment policy.
